0022600198.text: The Timberwolves host the Jazz as they reach their 11th game of the season, sitting at 6-3 overall (3-1 at home) and winning their last two, good for 8th in the West and 1 game back in third place in the Northwest. Utah is 1-7 and 14th in the West, and it enters on a six-game losing streak. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), Joan Beringer (out, fracture) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (out, hip bruise), while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (out, knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot strain). The two teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 147-111 win in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026.
